title: ProgressiveSwordMod
description: A sword that grows stronger with every kill! 6 levels, unique buffs, hidden mechanics, achievements and special attacks!
body:
## Features

A sword that grows stronger with every kill!

- **6 sword levels** (Wooden → Netherite)
- **Balanced damage** (5 → 25)
- **Auto-equipping armor** with enchantments (Protection + Unbreaking + Mending)
- **Unbreakable sword** - never breaks!

## Hidden Mechanics

- **Bloodlust** - 3 kills in 10 seconds = Speed III + Haste II
- **Soul Eater** - Every 10th kill = Regeneration + Absorption hearts
- **Combo System** - 5/10/15 kills without damage = bonus buffs

## Special Attack (Level 6)

- Right-click to unleash **Energy Wave**
- 10 damage + knockback in 5 block radius
- Costs 10 XP levels
- 30 second cooldown

## Commands

- `/progressivesword stats` - View your stats
- `/progressivesword setlevel <1-6> [player]` - Set sword level (OP)
- `/progressivesword addkills <number> [player]` - Add kills (OP)
- `/progressivesword reset [player]` - Reset progression (OP)

## Armor Progression

| Level | Armor | Enchantments |
|-------|-------|--------------|
| 2 | Leather | Protection I + Unbreaking I |
| 3 | Iron | Protection II + Unbreaking II |
| 4 | Gold | Protection III + Unbreaking II |
| 5 | Diamond | Protection IV + Unbreaking III |
| 6 | Netherite | Protection IV + Unbreaking III + Mending |

## Advancements

- 8 unique advancements for progression
- Toast notifications on unlock

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- **Forge** mod loader

## Installation

1. Download the `.jar` file
2. Place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.20.1

## Changelog

### Version 1.0.0 (First Release)

- 6 sword levels (Wooden → Netherite)
- Balanced damage (5 → 25)
- Auto-equipping armor with enchantments
- Hidden mechanics: Bloodlust, Soul Eater, Combo System
- Special attack (Energy Wave) on right-click (Level 6)
- 8 advancements
- Commands system
- Unbreakable sword
- Particle effects for each level
